classes.purpose: Recover the selected client engagement and advisory workspace
classes.content: Safe directory labels and stable client/engagement IDs; selected case path and manifest including client, project, objective, audience and language. Panel labels are app-only metadata; its chat handoff sends selected IDs. Subsequent agent reads of case briefs, workpapers or selected imported evidence enter model context. The adapter does not return source documents automatically.

classes.purpose: Find the same registered client and selected saved engagement across Vera, Lucia and Clara
classes.content: The three products on one computer reuse the approved archive root, safe client directory, private aliases and root-bound index. Selected client engagement listings may include work from all three product folders. No automatic document-content disclosure or cross-client input selection is added. Existing sealed paths and receipts remain unchanged.

security_controls.control: One shared owner-private profile supplies the approved archive root. Product session leases remain separate. New engagements use Vera, Lucia or Clara directories; readers resolve exact engagement IDs across these directories, reject duplicate identities and verify existing seals and client ownership. Technical client identity remains at Vera/client.json. Separate legacy archive roots are not moved or merged automatically.
